title: Minimum Enchant Level
description: Adds a side panel to the enchanting table GUI that lets you search enchantments and see the minimum bookshelf count and enchanting table level needed for each enchantment level.
body:
Minimum Enchant Level is a small quality-of-life mod for Fabric that improves the enchanting table interface.

When you open an enchanting table, the mod adds a side panel with a searchable list of enchantments. You can pick any enchantment from the list and instantly view extra information for each level of that enchantment.

The panel shows:

the minimum number of bookshelves needed
the minimum enchanting table level required
data for each enchantment level separately

This makes it much easier to understand when an enchantment can start appearing, without guessing or checking external wiki pages all the time.

Features
adds a side panel to the enchanting table screen
searchable enchantment list
quick enchantment selection with buttons
shows bookshelf requirements
shows minimum enchanting table level for each enchantment level
simple in-game interface, no commands needed
Why use this mod

Vanilla Minecraft does not clearly show when a specific enchantment can begin to appear in the enchanting table.
This mod is made to solve that problem by putting the information directly inside the enchanting screen, where you actually need it.

It is useful for players who:

want to optimize enchanting setups
want to know how many bookshelves are really needed
are looking for a specific enchantment
prefer in-game information instead of checking websites
Notes
designed for Fabric
built for Minecraft 1.21.11
focuses on making enchanting information easier to access
